title: Efficient Rhodamine B degradation via Fenton-like and E-Fenton processes using magnetic biochar from rubber seed shells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11327-11336
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01265A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
My Linh Nguyen, Thanh Tung Nguyen, Hoang Long Ngo
This research synthesized a magnetic catalyst by pyrolyzing rubber seed shell and incorporating α-FeOOH via precipitation. The best e-Fenton degradation activity of 91.67% was achieved, which was maintained over 60% after 6 runs.
